target.statement: Clean F1-score of PCA detector on SWaT pointwise benchmark (0.8134 ± 0.0038, mean over 3 seeds)
target.table_ref: Table V, row PCA, column Clean F1
target.dataset: SWaT (Secure Water Treatment), pointwise pool 449,919 samples x 44 features

compute.basis: PCA on ~276k x 44 normal training rows is seconds of CPU; the cost is obtaining SWaT (request-based access) and re-implementing the preprocessing/split/threshold pipeline from the repo, plus 3 seeds.

blockers: SWaT requires a signed request form to iTrust/SUTD; not freely downloadable
Repo link is a bare org URL in the PDF; exact code/config availability unverified
Preprocessing details (file alignment, dropped rows) must be matched to hit the exact F1
title: Robustness of Anomaly Detection Models for Industrial Control Systems under Training-Time Data Contamination
